extraction.Name: Lulu Trublood—nee Sears
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee to her 320 acre allotment when it was issued, April 13, 1918, but was informed that it would be taxed, and finally sold for same, if she did not take charge of her patent in fee, so she accepted it
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Mr. Krause of Batesland, South Dakota for $2000.00; let Mr. Krause have one quarter of her land in order to satisfy this mortgage; sold remaining quarter to George Demmers of Batesland, South Dakota for $2400 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she paid her taxes out of this loan
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband is a farmer; and that is his only source of income
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent; health fairly good; husband has good health and supports her and her eight minor children, who have good health; she considers she got almost nothing for her first quarter of land; about 1923 let Mr. Krause have one quarter to satisfy mortgage, releasing one quarter in her favor; about 1924 sold remaining quarter for $2400 cash, described as a poor price for good land; has received no help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document sworn December 7, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
